source: 720 Unexpected “Helper”
target: 720 Inopinatus “Adiutor”

source: The word “swindler” hung in the air, leaving Lumian and the others in stunned silence as similar thoughts raced through their minds.
target: Verbum “fraudator” in aere pendebat, relinquens Lumian et ceteros in stupefacto silentio, dum similes cogitationes per mentes eorum cucurrerent.

source: Surely they couldn’t be that unlucky, right?
target: Certe non poterant esse tam infausti, nonne?

source: Jebus had warned them about the possibility of running into swindlers during an Under the Table deal, but Franca’s previous experiences with Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction had always been reliable.
target: Jebus eos monuerat de possibilitate fraudatoribus incidendi in pacto sub mensa, sed experimenta praeterita Francae cum Transactio sub mensa a Titulari Auctoritatum semper fiebant certa.

source: Plus, the Blood Gold ring had been accepted this time around.
target: Praeterea, annulus “Blood Gold” hoc tempore acceptus erat.

source: If Lumian hadn’t been personally overseeing the transaction, he would’ve used the Eye of Calamity to assess the likelihood of it being finalized and look for ways to interfere.
target: Si Lumian transactionem non personaliter curaverat, Oculum Calamitatis ad aestimandum verisimilitudinem eius consummationis atque vias intercedendi quaerendos adhibuisset.

source: But for now, the four of them had no choice but to wait patiently.
target: Sed nunc, quattuor eorum nihil aliud facere potuerant quam patienter exspectare.

source: Hidden behind the dark, watery light, they watched the scene unfolding in the study through the glass mirror.
target: Sub obscuro et aquoso lumine absconditi, spectabant scaenam in studiō evolventem per speculum vitrum.

source: As the night wore on, Lumian and his companions nibbled on the rations he’d packed for Ludwig in his Traveler’s Bag to keep their hunger at bay.
target: Dum nox progrediebatur, Lumian et comites eius victus parvos, quos pro Ludovico in sacco Itineris paraverat, deglutiebant ut famem temperarent.

source: Close to 10 p.m., Moran Avigny strode into the study, leaving the wooden door wide open.
target: Circiter ad horam decimam vespertinam, Moran Avigny in studiō processit, relinquens ostium ligneum late apertum.

source: He sank into an armchair beneath the gas wall lamp, grabbed a book from a nearby pile, and began casually flipping through it.
target: Sub lampade gasi parietali, in sellam armachiem consedit, librum ex pila proxima arripuit, et leniter per paginas illius transire coepit.

source: The Purifier team tasked with his protection remained stationed at the door as usual, never setting foot inside.
target: Turma Purificatorum, quae eum protegere debebat, ut solitum erat, ad ostium mansit, numquam intus ingrediens.

source: Moran Avigny had always insisted on this arrangement.
target: Moran Avigny semper hanc dispositionem instabat.

source: He’d even signed contracts with the Purifiers, Machinery Hivemind members, and Bureau 8 team, acknowledging that he was willing to take on the associated risks.
target: Etiam cum Purificatoribus, membris Machinery Hivemind, et turmis Bureau 8 contractus subscripsit, agnoscens se pericula huiusmodi subire paratum esse.

source: The security detail understood.
target: Custodes intellexerunt.

source: A politician’s study likely concealed all sorts of shady secrets.
target: Studium politicum probabiliter celabat omnia genera obscurarum arcanorum.

source: Keeping people with Beyonder powers from entering was a way for Moran Avigny to protect himself.
target: Impediendo homines cum facultatibus Beyonder intrare, Moran Avigny se protegebat.

source: As was his custom, Moran Avigny left the study door open instead of shutting it, making it simpler for the Purifiers to keep an eye out for any potential trouble.
target: Ut morebatur, Moran Avigny ostium studii aperitum relinquebat, potius quam claudebat, ut Purificatores facilem speciem cuiuslibet futurae perturbationis inspicere possent.

source: While perusing the books, Moran Avigny would occasionally glance up at the full‐length mirror positioned just out of the Purifiers’ line of sight, his thoughts seemingly far away.
target: Dum libros perlegit, interdum Moran Avigny sursum speculum totum positum, extra lineam visus Purificatorum intuebatur, cum eius cogitationes remotas videbantur.

source: At the same time, Lumian’s eyes, hidden within the mirror, glinted a silvery‐black.
target: Simul, oculi Luminum, in speculo occulti, micabant in luce nigro–argentea.

source: Peering through the glass, he studied Moran Avigny’s river of fate.
target: Per vitrum intuebatur, et flumen fatum Moran Avigny diligenter contemplatus est.

source: Looking closer, he confirmed that the Minister of Industry had indeed gained several new fate tributaries involving stepping into the full‐length mirror.
target: Propius intuebatur, confirmavit Minister Industriae revera plures novas fatum tributarias adeptus esse, quae implicabant ingressum in speculum totum.

source: One of them was even cloaked in a thick, black hue.
target: Unus eorum etiam crasso et nigro tegmine velatus erat.

source: Seizing the moment when Moran Avigny ducked his head to resume reading, Lumian slowly reached his right palm out from the mirror, pressing it firmly against the glass as if it were merely a reflection.
target: Aprehendens momentum, cum Moran Avigny caput inclinavit ut legendum resumere, Lumian paulatim dextram manum ex speculo protulit, eam contra vitrum firmiter prementem, quasi solum reflexus esset.

source: Then, he unleashed his remaining spirituality, transforming it into a raging, phantom river that surged toward the mercury stream symbolizing Moran Avigny’s fate from a few meters away.
target: Tum reliquam spiritualitatem suam efferre coepit, eam in flumen phantasmatum et furibundum vertens, quod ad flumen mercurii, fati Moran Avigny repraesentans, paucos metra propinquo impetum habebat.

source: The main trunk of Moran Avigny’s fate swallowed up the other tributaries and rushed into the dense, black one.
target: Truncus principalis fati Moran Avigny reliquas tributarias absorpsit atque in densum, nigrum cursum properavit.

source: Compelling Fate!
target: Fatum compellens!

source: Channeling the spirituality he’d accumulated using his Ascetic abilities, Lumian quickly withdrew his palm to avoid tipping off Moran Avigny.
target: Spiritualitatem, quam per virtutes asceticās collegerat, canalizans, Lumian celeriter retractavit dextram manum, ne Moran Avigny id admoneretur.

source: He gave Franca and the others a nod, signaling that both the Under the Table deal and his Compelling of Fate had been successful.
target: Francae et ceteris annuens, significavit quod et pactum sub mensa et fatum compellens feliciter evenissent.

source: As for the exact way Moran Avigny would embark on this fated path, Lumian couldn’t say.
target: Quod attinet ad modum exactum quo Moran Avigny hunc fatum iter inciperet, Lumian dicere non potuit.

source: The details were beyond his sight.
target: Singula extra conspectum eius erant.

source: Franca and Jenna let out sighs of relief.
target: Franca et Jenna suspiria levationis emiserunt.

source: Not daring to speak lest they alert Moran Avigny, who possessed mirror‐related abilities, they shared their understanding with Lumian through gratified smiles and relaxed nods.
target: Non ausi loqui ne Moran Avigny, qui facultates speculi habebat, avertirentur, intellegentiam suam cum Lumiano communicaverunt per risus gratos et annos lenes.

source: They retreated to their positions, preparing for the upcoming ambush.
target: Se recedebant ad sua loca, praeparantes ad insidias venturas.

source: Just as fate was being compelled, Moran Avigny’s spirituality abruptly sensed a warning, filling him with a feeling of impending danger.
target: Iam, cum fatum compellendum esset, spiritualitas Moran Avigny subito signum monitionis sensit, eum per sensum imminentis periculi replevit.

source: The mirror message he’d received at dusk sprang to mind, and he started to suspect that the unknown enemy the Overseer had mentioned was plotting something that could put his life at risk.
target: Nuntius speculi, quem ad vesperum accepit, mente revocatus est, et coepit suspicari hostem ignotum, quem Overseor mentionaverat, aliquid machinari quod vitam eius in discrimen adduceret.

source: Unable to resist, Moran Avigny glanced at the full‐length mirror once more, debating whether to flee into it and abandon this place before the Purifiers had a chance to react.
target: Non posse resistere, Moran Avigny iterum in speculum totum intuebatur, deliberans utrum in illud fugiendum esset et hunc locum relinquendum antequam Purificatores agere possent.

source: He yearned to shed his current identity and vanish completely from the hidden enemy’s radar.
target: Desiderabat identitatem suam praesentem abicere et omnino evanescere ex radario hostis occulti.

source: Fighting back his impulses, he turned his head to look at the Purifiers standing guard at the door.
target: Pugnans impulsus suos reprimebat, caput vertens ad Purificatores stantes ad ostium spectare.

source: There could be a trap lurking behind the mirror.
target: Forsitan insidiae lateant post speculum.

source: His best bet was to pray that the official Beyonders would be able to shield him!
target: Optimum consilium eius erat orare ut Beyonderi officiales eum tueri possent!

source: This is Trier, and I’m a minister of the country!
target: Hic est Trier, et ego minister patriae sum!

source: Right then, his valet appeared at the door, carrying a glass of warm milk.
target: Statim tunc, valet eius ad ostium apparuit, poculum vitreo lactis calidi ferens.

source: Drinking warm milk before showering and brushing his teeth was part of Moran Avigny’s nightly routine to help him sleep.
target: Bibere lac calidum ante se lavandum et dentes purgandos pars erat consuetudinis vespertinae Moran Avigny, ad dormitum eum adiuvandum.

source: The Purifiers carried out their standard checks before permitting the valet to enter the study.
target: Purificatores regulas proprias perfecerunt antequam valetum in studiō ingredi licuisset.

source: “Your milk, Sir,” the valet said deferentially, extending a white porcelain cup brimming with the liquid.
target: “Lac tuum, Domine,” valet deferenter dixit, calicem album porcellaneum liquidum plenum extendens.

source: Moran Avigny had made immense contributions to Intis’s industrial growth and had been awarded the Legion of Honor medal, earning him the rank of Knight.
target: Moran Avigny ingentes contributiones ad incrementum industriale Intis fecerat et medallium Legionis Honor adeptus erat, gradum Equitis comparans.

source: Nodding his head slightly, Moran Avigny reached out his right hand to accept the glass.
target: Paululum caput annuens, Moran Avigny dextram manum protulit ad poculum accipiendum.

source: All of a sudden, he noticed his valet’s eyes cloud over, an indescribable agony lurking in their depths.
target: Subito animadvertit oculos valeti sui nubilos fieri, cum in imis eorum dolor ineffabilis latuit.

source: A heartbeat later, the valet’s mouth flew open and he vomited.
target: Post unum ictum cordis, os valeti patefactum est et vomuit.

source: What he spat out was a solid, writhing chunk of blood-colored flesh, hurled directly at Moran Avigny!
target: Quod vomuit, frustum solidum et contortum carnis sanguinei colore, directe in Moran Avigny iactum est!

source: The flesh swiftly ballooned, morphing into a cloak of flesh and blood that wrapped around Moran Avigny.
target: Caro celeriter inflavit, formans pallium ex carne et sanguine, quod circa Moran Avigny involutum est.

source: It wriggled inward, seemingly trying to force its way into the Minister of Industry’s body.
target: Intus contorquebatur, quasi viam suam in corpus Ministri Industriae intromitti conaretur.

source: In the mirror, Lumian was stunned.
target: In speculo, Lumian stupefactus erat.

source: This aura…
target: Haec aura…

source: It’s Mr. K!
target: Est Dominus K!

source: Why had he shown up out of nowhere to try to assassinate Moran Avigny?
target: Cur ex nusquam apparuit ut Moran Avigny interficeret?

source: With a sharp crack, Moran Avigny, cocooned in the flesh‐and‐blood cloak, transformed into a mirror and shattered.
target: Cum acuto crepitu, Moran Avigny, in pallio carne et sanguine involutus, in speculum conversus est et confractus est.

source: Nearly simultaneously, the Purifiers at the door sprang into action.
target: Paene simul, Purificatores ad ostium in actionem subitam accesserunt.

source: A column of pure light wreathed in flames plummeted from the sky, bathing the cloak and causing it to visibly start melting.
target: Columna luminis puri, flammis circumdata, de caelo labens descendit, pallium operiens et evidenter liquefieri coepisse faciens.

source: Witnessing this, Moran Avigny spun around without hesitation and lunged at the mirror nearest to him.
target: Hoc videns, Moran Avigny sine mora circumvertit et in speculum proximum sibi impetum fecit.

source: He had already revealed Mirror Substitution to the Purifiers.
target: Iam speculi substitutionem Purificatoribus revelaverat.

source: Short of eliminating every witness without a trace, he would undoubtedly face intense scrutiny later on and lose the protection of the contract.
target: Nisi omnes testes sine vestigio tolleretur, certo postea severam inspectionem subiret et tutelam contractus amitteret.

source: His only option was to take advantage of this chance to escape through the mirror world while the Purifiers tangled with the assassin!
target: Sola eius optio erat ut occasionem hujus caperet, per mundum speculi effugiendi, dum Purificatores cum sicario certabant!

source: As he watched Moran Avigny’s figure loom larger and nearer to the full‐length mirror, a thought abruptly struck Lumian.
target: Dum figuram Moran Avigny, quae in speculo toto magis et propius appropinquabat, intuebatur, subito Lumian cogitationem accepit.

source: Could this be fate?
target: Num hoc fatum sit?

source: He instantly retreated and disappeared.
target: Statim se recepit atque evanuit.

source: A moment later, Moran Avigny’s figure passed through the mirror, emerging behind the hazy, shadowy, and nearly vacant looking glass.
target: Momento post, figura Moran Avigny per speculum transiit, emergens post vitrum nebulosum, umbratile, et paene vacuum aspectum habens.

source: The Purifiers outside were shocked to see this.
target: Purificatores foris stupefacti sunt, hoc videndo.

source: At the same time, they grasped that something was seriously wrong with the target under their protection.
target: Simul intellexerunt aliquid grave de scopo, quem protegebant, esse.

source: Their attention wavered briefly.
target: Eorum attentio paulisper vacillavit.

source: Taking advantage of the distraction, Mr. K changed Grazing targets and teleported away from Moran Avigny’s residence.
target: Utefacta distractione, Mr. K metas pascendi mutavit et ab domicilio Moran Avigny celeriter discessit.

source: In the space behind the mirror, Moran Avigny didn’t linger.
target: In spatio post speculum, Moran Avigny non remansit.

source: He promptly activated Mirror Traversal, rapidly changing positions to throw off any would-be pursuers.
target: Celeriter “Mirror Traversal” activavit, ac statuas celeriter mutans ut quoslibet insequentis confunderet.

source: Just then, he felt his body grow inexplicably heavier, his movements oddly constricted, stopping him from successfully slipping into an empty, dark tunnel.
target: Tunc sensit corpus suum inexplicabiliter gravius fieri atque motus eius insolite contrahendi, quod eum prohibebat ne feliciter in tuniculum vacuum et obscurum incidere posset.

source: It was as though someone had seized him.
target: Quasi aliquis eum apprehenderat.

source: Right after that, Moran Avigny sensed invisible threads coiling around his limbs and torso, layer upon layer.
target: Mox postea, Moran Avigny sensit fila invisibilia circa membra et corpus suum circumvoluta, stratum super stratum.

source: With his Sheriff powers, he pinpointed the source of the sinister threads.
target: Cum viribus praefectoriis, radicem horum filorum sinistrorum innotuit.

source: They were close by.
target: Erant prope.

source: Moran Avigny angled his head marginally and peered at an empty corner.
target: Modice caput inclinavit et in angulum vacuum intuebatur.

source: His eyes flashed with two blinding “lightning bolts.”
target: Oculi eius duos fulmina caecantia micaverunt.

source: Psychic Piercing!
target: Perforatio psychica!

source: The “lightning” lanced out, hitting the empty spot.
target: Fulmen exsulavit, locum vacuum percutiens.

source: A sharp cracking rang out, scattering shards of shattered mirrors.
target: Acuto crepitu auditus est, dispersans fragmenta speculorum confractarum.

source: At the same instant, Jenna, dressed in a black gown and veiled bonnet, materialized behind Moran Avigny, gripping a small, elegant revolver.
target: Idem tempore, Jenna, induta veste nigra et pileo velato, post Moran Avigny apparuit, revolverum parvum atque elegantem tenens.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: She squeezed the trigger, targeting Moran Avigny’s vest.
target: Illa trigerum premuit, destinans ictum in vestem Moran Avigny.

source: The yellow bullet, wreathed in silent black flames, struck the target’s body with precision at close range.
target: Bala flava, in tacitas flammas nigras involuta, corpus destinatum prope cum praecisione percussit.

source: Crack! Moran Avigny deployed Mirror Substitution yet again.
target: Crepitus! Moran Avigny speculi substitutionem iterum diffudit.

source: As broken mirrors rained down, his figure rematerialized in a different corner of the hazy space.
target: Dum specula confracta pluvia cadebant, figura eius in angulo diverso spatii nebulosi rursum apparuit.

source: Franca and Jenna vanished without a trace.
target: Franca et Jenna sine ullo vestigio evanuerunt.

source: Feeling the intangible threads enveloping him, Moran Avigny thrust out his right palm and intoned in ancient Hermes, “Invisibility is prohibited here!”
target: Sensu filorum intangibilium eum circumvolventium, Moran Avigny dextram manum protulit et in antiqua lingua Hermetica intonavit: “Invisibilitas hic prohibetur!”

source: The instant he uttered the final word, innumerable transparent spider silks undulated throughout the area, resembling seaweed blanketing a section of ocean.
target: Statim quo verbum extremum edixit, innumerabiles filum transparentium araneorum per totam aream undulabant, similes algis marinis partem oceani tegens.

source: Franca, garbed as an Assassin, and Jenna, clad in dark attire, circled or advanced, respectively, poised to strike again.
target: Franca, ut Sicaria induta, et Jenna, veste obscura induta, circulabant vel progrediebantur, respective, paratae ad iterum feriendum.

source: Realizing that the two foes couldn’t touch him for the moment and that the invisible spider silk hadn’t constricted, Moran Avigny had no time for a counterattack.
target: Animadvertens hostes duo eum pro tempore tangere non posse et filum araneum invisibile non constrictum esse, Moran Avigny nullum tempus ad repugnationem habuit.

source: He immediately sought to use Mirror Traversal to flee the area.
target: Statim quaesivit uti “Mirror Traversal” ut aream effugeret.

source: Out of nowhere, Moran Avigny’s eyes bulged, his expression contorting with viciousness.
target: Ex nihilo, oculi Moran Avigny protulere, et vultus eius crudeli deformatus est.

source: His body shattered once more, assuming the shape of a mirror.
target: Corpus eius iterum confractum est, speculi formam assumens.

source: Not far off, Anthony Reid, dressed like a veteran, “appeared.”
target: Non longe, Anthony Reid, indutus ut veteranus, apparuit.

source: He had just cast Frenzy on Moran Avigny!
target: Nuper Frenzy in Moran Avigny immisit!

source: The Prohibition of Invisibility rule didn’t constrain him since he wasn’t invisible.
target: Regula invisibilitatis eum non coercebat, quoniam ipse invisibilis non erat.

source: However, Moran Avigny himself hadn’t been looking in Anthony’s direction!
target: Attamen, Moran Avigny ipse non ad Anthonyum spectabat!

source: After employing Mirror Substitution multiple times, Moran Avigny rematerialized on the far side of the space, putting distance between himself and Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
target: Post pluries speculi substitutionem usum, Moran Avigny in parte extrema spatii rematerializatus est, distantiam inter se et Francam, Jennam, atque Anthonyum imponens.

source: Grasping that yet another enemy had entered the fray, he fled with intensified urgency.
target: Animadvertens quod iterum hostis in certamen intraverat, celeriter evasit cum intensa urgentia.

source: Right as Moran Avigny was poised to activate Mirror Traversal, Franca lowered her hood, unveiling her radiant, refined features.
target: Statim, cum Moran Avigny paratus esset “Mirror Traversal” activare, Franca cappa sua deiecit, lineamenta sua radiosa ac exquisita revelans.

source: As she did, the diamond necklace adorning her neck emitted a subtle glow.
target: Dum id feceret, monile adamantinum, quod collum eius ornabat, levem fulgor emisit.

source: Beatrice’s Necklace!
target: Monile Beatricis!

source: Moran Avigny’s body flushed with heat, his gaze magnetized to Franca’s lake-blue eyes, her high, delicate nose bridge, her fair, flawless skin, and her lush, crimson lips.
target: Corpus Moran Avigny calore rubescens, oculi eius ad oculos Francae, caeruleos ut lacus, nasus altus et delicatus, cutis nitida et sine macula, labraque opima, coccinea, traxerunt.

source: For an instant, his desire to escape slipped his mind.
target: Instanti, desiderium eius effugiendi mente evanuit.

source: The activation of Beatrice’s Necklace didn’t pose a direct threat to Moran Avigny’s life, so it failed to trigger Mirror Substitution.
target: Activatio Monili Beatricis non afferebat minas directas ad vitam Moran Avigny, itaque non excitavit “Mirror Substitution.”

source: Moran Avigny lacked the time to deploy it himself.
target: Moran Avigny tempus ad id ipsi exsequi non habebat.

source: His cravings had already swelled beyond his control!
target: Eius desideria iam ultra sui imperium extollerant!
